name: AzureFilm d.o.o.
summary: Slovenian filament manufacturer registered in Sezana with operations in Ljubljana, founded by the Derman family (brand launched 2014, family enterprise roots from 1968). Unusually, it builds its own extrusion lines and tooling in-house (mold making, injection molding, CNC milling), sells 3D printers alongside filament, and offers private-label/OEM production to third-party brands - making it a potential upstream OEM as well as a retail brand.

oem_relationships.notes: AzureFilm's own marketing advertises private-label options, i.e. it produces filament for other brands. Direction is AzureFilm as supplier TO others, not the reverse. No client brand has been identified and this does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md - flagged there as a new candidate row for further research rather than established fact.

product_lines.name: PLA Strongman
product_lines.notes: Marketed as a higher-toughness PLA; no TDS-level composition is published, so pla-plus cannot be confirmed

product_lines.name: ABS Prime / ABS Plus
product_lines.notes: Standard ABS; Plus is likely impact-modified but this is not confirmed from public sources

product_lines.name: Carbon Fiber PAHT
product_lines.notes: High-temperature nylon + carbon fibre, rated for continuous use to 160 C; the PA subtype (PA6 vs PA6/66) is undisclosed, so pa6-cf and ppa-cf cannot be confirmed and no generic pa-cf id exists

product_lines.name: Flexible filaments (TPU)
product_lines.notes: Standard TPU line; Shore hardness not published, so no grade id can be assigned

product_lines.name: Refill filaments
product_lines.notes: Same chemistries sold in refill spool format, not a distinct material

product_lines.name: 3D printers and spare parts
product_lines.notes: Hardware, not filament; AzureFilm also builds its own production machinery

additional_notes: Roughly $20-28/kg per a third-party review aggregator - budget-to-mid, sold largely direct rather than through major marketplaces. Related Slovenian registry entities 'AZUREFILM GROUP d.o.o.' and 'AZUREFILM PROIZVODNJA 3D TISKALNIKOV IN FILAMENTOV D.O.O.' suggest a group/holding structure; the exact corporate relationship between them is unverified. Third-party reviews report batch-to-batch variance and occasionally loose spool winding despite a stated +/-0.02 mm tolerance. Whether print surfaces are included in the printer spare-parts range was not established, so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: The private-label/OEM relationship rests solely on AzureFilm's own marketing with no named client brand, so the oem_relationships entry uses a placeholder company name and should be replaced once a client is identified. Corporate structure across the three AzureFilm registry entities is unresolved. Stated +/-0.02 mm tolerance conflicts with third-party reports of batch variance.
